claims.text: The UNC Physics and Astronomy department history names the Air Force route into the Institute of Field Physics as the Aeronautical Research Laboratory at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, not the Wright Air Development Center: 'Joshua Goldberg was, at the time of the establishment of the IOFP and the conference, in charge of aspects of the Air Force's funding of general relativity, in the "modern physics research branch" (based at the Aeronautical Research Laboratory at Wright Patterson Air Force Base).' The page uses neither 'Wright Air Development Center' nor 'WADC'.
